This issue and your GitHub account name are public immediately. Remove credentials, private account or session IDs, and confidential details. For a private response, email enquiries@tntresearch.co.uk instead.

## Note ID and revision

TC-001, TC-002 or TC-003; include the `revision_id` from `notes.json`. If this is a new question, say so.

## Coding agent, model and platform

Agent product and version; model provider and exact model ID if reported (otherwise `unknown`); client or platform and relevant version. Omit private identifiers.

## Smallest failing case

Give the event sequence, inputs or test that exposes the problem. Synthetic data is welcome.

## Expected answer

What should the system be able to say, and what remains unknown from the available evidence?

## Missing distinction

Which fact, time meaning, ordering relation or provenance link does the note or your model fail to preserve?

## Optional supporting material

Links to a public test or code example, if useful. Do not include secrets or confidential data.
